summary: All 6 acceptance_matrix criteria exercised across backend + dev-server + static-SPA + public-preview lanes. All checks passed.
action_items: Note: static SPA requires React hydration to finish before interactive elements respond to clicks (SSR-first paint looks interactive but isn't until hydrated) - not a bug, but noted for anyone writing further automation against this app: wait for 'load' + networkidle (or a hydration marker) before clicking, not just domcontentloaded.

notes: The acceptance_matrix listed 6 criteria but several bundle multiple UI assertions (static SPA criterion alone covers 6 distinct flows); each flow got its own named browser check per the one-flow-per-check rule, totalling 15 check artifacts across backend/browser lanes.

A test-authoring artifact was caught and corrected during this run: Playwright's `.fill()` on this app's controlled inputs combined with `domcontentloaded` navigation produced false negatives (clicks appeared to do nothing) because React hydration hadn't finished yet on this SSR app. Switching to `waitUntil: 'load'` + `networkidle` (or `keyboard.type` for fills) resolved it and confirmed the app's real behavior is correct. This was verified as NOT an app bug via DOM-level native click dispatch tests, direct-URL navigation cross-checks, and successful reruns.

No credentials exist per briefing; only negative-login and guest flows were exercised, consistent with spec_deviations noting logged-in flows (submit spot, admin approve) are out of scope without credentials.
